main.description: A comment on a node or on another comment. In a context's space it is part of that context's discussion, read by its members; in a public repository it is a public comment on a public item. The same shape in both, so that a thread reads the same wherever it is.

subject.description: What the thread hangs on: the node, or the public record.

parent.description: The comment this one answers, when it answers one.

author.description: Who wrote it, when the record is held by the organization for them. Absent in its author's own repository, where the repository says who.

tombstone.description: Emptied by its author or an owner and kept because answers hang on it: no text, no author, no picture.

legacyId.description: Its id in the interim, for what was carried over.
